descriptions.usem.cdp.remtask.fields.sn_vul_vulnerabi: CDP required fields sent for sn_vul_vulnerability remediation tasks (sheet Outbound to CDP (RemTask)). One servicenow_field=json_field pair per line, each line ending with a comma, in payload order; a field missing on the table or empty is sent as "". The table is supported only while this property exists.
